facts.statement: With zh-CN, the base parser returns invalid dates for numeric and wide-form October; the same evaluator reports month 1 for numeric November and December.

diagnosis.root_cause: The Chinese month match and parse alternatives accept ambiguous prefixes for the two-digit months, allowing a shorter month token to win before the complete October-through-December token is classified.

plan.behavioral_objective: Recognize complete October, November, and December tokens before classifying their numeric or Chinese prefixes, for both abbreviated and wide zh-CN month forms.
constraints: Continue accepting months one through nine.
Preserve narrow, abbreviated, and wide matching contracts.
Do not consume digits beyond a complete one-digit month token.
non_goals: Do not alter unrelated locale text.
